root_idea.summary: The root centers on building: joining parts together to form a whole, structure, or established configuration.
root_idea.development: From physical construction, the lexicon extends to structures and their forms, the establishment of honor or status, and relational terms for offspring as those brought into being or formed by a parent.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Quranic plural بنات is presented under the singular dictionary citation بِنْت.
The group contains the plural forms بني/بنون and the diminutive بُنَيّ; these are represented under the normalized citation form اِبْن with distinct usage senses.
The Quranic feminine form is normalized to the passive-participle citation form مَبْنِيّ.
The Quranic form ابنَت is an inflected form of the feminine citation noun بِنْت.

senses.definition: To build, construct, or raise a structure.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of constructing or forming a physical structure, including the heavens and other built or established structures; the Quranic forms include perfect, imperfect, and imperative forms.

senses.definition: A daughter; a female child in relation to a parent.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran uses the singular and plural forms بِنْت and بَنَات, including in claims about daughters attributed to a deity and in direct familial reference.

senses.definition: A builder; one whose work is building.
senses.usage_conditions: An occupational noun denoting a person engaged in building or construction.

senses.definition: A built thing, building, or structure.
senses.usage_conditions: A noun for something constructed or established; the Quranic occurrences refer to the heaven as a construction or covering.

senses.definition: A roof, ceiling, or canopy spread over or pitched above something.
senses.usage_conditions: A Quranic construction in which the sky is described as a covering above the earth; the historical citation in the lexical evidence is not treated as a modern verse reference.

senses.definition: A son or male child; in the plural, sons, children, or descendants belonging to a named parent, ancestor, or people.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran uses اِبْن for an individual son and plural forms such as أَبْنَاء, بَنُون, بَنِينَ, and بَنِي for family, lineage, and community designations.

senses.definition: A person closely connected with or characterized by the following noun, in an established relational compound; in the Quran, ابن السبيل denotes a wayfarer or traveler.
senses.usage_conditions: This is a conventional compound use rather than a claim of biological sonship; the Quranic expression ابن السبيل identifies one connected with the road through travel.

senses.definition: A little son or dear child, expressed by the diminutive بُنَيّ.
senses.usage_conditions: Used especially in affectionate or intimate address, including the Quranic vocative يَا بُنَيَّ.
A noun for a constructed structure, including a structure conceived as a unified or solid whole.
A passive participle describing something made into a structure; the Quranic occurrence is feminine in agreement with غرف.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bring a bride to the bridegroom or consummate the marriage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional use of بَنَى عَلَى or بَنَى بِـ, originally associated with pitching and furnishing a tent for the bride.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To establish or raise a house of nobility, honor, or high status.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of building applied to attaining elevated degrees or collective distinction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make the body or flesh grow and become large.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of food as the agent producing bodily growth or fattening.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rear, bring up, or educate a person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative developmental use of the verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To form or construct a word.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical linguistic use of building imagery applied to the formation of a word.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The fixed grammatical form of a word, with an invariant ending.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A grammatical technical term for a word remaining on one termination, such as a fixed sukūn or vowel, independently of a governing word.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give a poem a specified rhyme letter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A poetic construction in which the poem is made to follow a particular final or chief rhyme.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a bow to cling to its string so tightly that the string nearly breaks.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of a bow's faulty relation to its string.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To build repeatedly, extensively, or on many objects.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form II pattern can mark frequency, intensity, or application to numerous structures.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone build, or to provide him with a building or the means to build one.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV is causative and may mean giving a house, tent, or building materials.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To introduce a man to his wife on the occasion of marriage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative marital use related to the construction-based marriage expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a seated woman to become tent-like in shape or to spread her legs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression compares bodily shape or posture with a pitched skin tent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a camel's hump to become fat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized bodily-growth use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To adopt someone as a son, or claim him as a son.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form V relational use of taking or asserting someone as one's son.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become built, framed, or constructed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive or passive-result use of Form VIII.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The form, mode, or manner of building or construction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe how something is formed or constructed rather than the resulting structure itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Natural bodily constitution or physical build.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions describing someone as sound or healthy in constitution.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An established state of glory, nobility, or honor conceived metaphorically as a building.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension distinguished in the lexical evidence from construction of a physical object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The body together with its limbs or members.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use referring to the bodily composition or assembled bodily whole.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A leather spread used on the ground, especially as a surface for food or prayer.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized traditional object, also identified with نِطْع.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Small roads or paths branching from a main road.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A diminutive-derived idiom for subsidiary routes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In an idiomatic comparison, something regarded as the offspring or derivative of another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Illustrated by the proverbial expression treating gentleness as the 'son' of forbearance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sonship or the condition of being a son.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An abstract noun denoting the filial relation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The Kaaba, regarded as the noble building.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional honorific designation, including in oaths and the expression بَنِيَّةُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who builds, frames, or constructs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active participle distinct from the occupational noun بَنَّاء.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bridegroom, or one going in to his wife.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional extension from the marital use of بَنَى عَلَى أَهْلِهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Clinging to a bowstring, or, in a dialectal usage, widely separated from it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized bow description with variant interpretation in the lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man who bends himself over his bowstring when shooting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun associated with the bow and string.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Small arrows.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate technical nominal use reported for the same form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The ribs or breast bones, the shoulder blades and legs, or the legs of a she-camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form is also used in idioms for settling or taking up residence, and for rain held by the sky.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A more remote male descendant, such as a son's son, by extension of the son relation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader genealogical extension beyond the immediate son sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An individual or member of a non-human class designated in an ابن compound.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: For irrational beings, the plural may take بنات, as in established terms for camels or stars.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A doll or dolls used by young girls in play.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative plural use distinct from the kinship noun daughter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Adam, literally the son of earth or clay.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed compound designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In lexicalized compounds, a person characterized by or closely associated with the following noun, including a thief, warrior, or rich man.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Examples include ابن الليل and ابن الطريق for a thief or robber, ابن حرب for a warrior or defender, and ابن الدنيا for a rich man; these are distinct from the Quranic ابن السبيل use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A named animal or creature in fixed compounds, such as a jackal or weasel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Examples include ابن آوى and ابن عرس.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A skin container for water or milk made from one or more hides.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The compound distinguishes containers made from one, two, or three hides.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An echo.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed compound meaning literally the daughter of the mountain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Calamities or misfortunes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in fixed expressions such as بَنَاتُ بَئْسٍ and related compounds.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pebbles of the mosques of God, in a rare figurative expression.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic characterization rather than a literal kinship expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A girl whose flesh has grown or become large; an alternative interpretation relates the phrase to the sweet odor of flesh.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical evidence reports both interpretations and records disagreement over the wording.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A skin screen, tent-like hide structure, mat, leather spread, or receptacle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term covers several traditional objects made from joined skins, including a small tent-like enclosure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Raised high, especially a palace or pavilion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II passive-participle-derived adjective or noun, distinct from the Form I passive participle مَبْنِيّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The act of building, framing, or constructing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use of the Form VIII passive participle in place of the verbal noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of or relating to a son or daughter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relational adjective derived from اِبْن or بِنْت; the lexical evidence records relational uses referring to both sons and daughters, with variant forms.

cautions: The Quranic form group bunaY~ combines ordinary plural forms such as بَنِي and بَنُون with the diminutive بُنَيَّ; these are retained under اِبْن with separate senses rather than treated as unrelated roots.
The QAC packet flags 20:94:2 in the metadata for the ابنَت group as a multi-root location, while that location is listed among the اِبْن occurrences and is not separately assigned to بِنْت.
Lane's historical Quran citation in the بِنَاء discussion is preserved as lexical evidence but is not converted into a modern surah:ayah reference.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: QAC marks 20:94:2 as an ambiguous multi-root location in the form-group metadata for qac-form:bny:{bonat:nominal:-}; the packet's occurrence lists place 20:94:2 under qac-form:bny:{bon:nominal:-}, so no additional daughter-form occurrence is claimed.
